origin:West Asia / Middle East vs Eastern Europe
method.target: A=+1, B=-1, tie=0; verbal strength ignored; score scale is not money
method.fit: Ridge least squares; monotone nonnegative shade/age/tare increments; free provenance offsets; no interactions
method.models: Identical feature family. Exact: zero tie band. Near-tie: symmetric band tuned on training-only folds.
method.cv: 5 outer grouped folds x 5 seeds; inner 3 grouped folds select ridge strength and decision band by balanced accuracy
method.group: unordered provenance pair and unordered shade pair; all age/tare variants together
method.historical_caveat: Round 9 was already inspected before this comparison was designed. Training excludes it, but results are retrospective, not a new pristine holdout.
method.cv_caveat: Repeated splits reuse the same 119 answers; ranges are split sensitivity, not confidence intervals or independent new samples.
method.threshold_semantics: Prediction of an elicited tie; does not rewrite exact-tie answers or assert equal dollar prices.
